newsitem.title: USA: Watkins-Johnson adopts holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Watkins-Johnson adopts holder rights plan.

text.p: Watkins-Johnson Co said its board of directors approved an extension and revision of its 1986 shareholder rights plan which expires next month.
The company said the new plan is not being instituted in response to any known effort to acquire control of the company.
Under the plan, a dividend of one purchase right is being declared for each share of common stock outstanding at the close of business on October 10, 1996.

The rights will not become exercisable until any person or group, not previously approved by the board, acquires at least 15 percent of Watkins-Johnson's common stock or announces a tender offer for at least that much stock.
